batch_meta.notes: Batch 4 of 4. Covers 10 peptides spanning FDA-approved drugs (pramlintide Symlin, oxytocin Pitocin, sermorelin Geref-archived), ex-US approvals (thymosin-alpha-1 Zadaxin), failed clinical programs (aviptadil/VIP, ipamorelin, cjc-1295), pipeline (cagrilintide), and research-only (epithalon, ghk-cu). DailyMed used for Symlin and Pitocin. Vd populated where available: pramlintide not published in label; Pitocin not published; sermorelin Vd 23.7-25.8 L (Geref label); aviptadil/VIP Vd ~14 mL/kg (Domschke 1978); ipamorelin Vss 0.22 L/kg (existing Raun data); thymosin-alpha-1 dose-prop SC PK; cagrilintide t1/2 ~7 d, Vd not formally published. Pre-existing atlas already cites Pitocin DailyMed, Raun 1998 (ipamorelin), Teichman 2006 (cjc-1295), Geref label (sermorelin), Pickart 1980 (ghk-cu) - those URLs are not duplicated here. All injectable peptides use first_pass='not_applicable'. Vendor pricing populated for 9 of 10 (no research-grade pramlintide source verified). Finnrick has completed product pages for sermorelin, cjc-1295, ghk-cu, cagrilintide, ipamorelin (and paid-only test pages for vip, epithalon).

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: SYMLIN / SymlinPen (pramlintide acetate); originator Amylin Pharmaceuticals, now AstraZeneca
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Adjunct mealtime therapy with insulin in adults with T1D or insulin-using T2D who have failed to achieve glycemic control on optimal insulin therapy
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Marketed prescription drug; SymlinPen 60 and SymlinPen 120 disposable multidose pen-injectors. Boxed warning for severe insulin-induced hypoglycemia.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Pramlintide is metabolized primarily by the kidney. Primary metabolite Des-lys1 pramlintide (2-37 pramlintide) retains in vitro activity. Plasma t1/2 ~48 min in healthy volunteers; SC bioavailability 30-40%; Tmax ~19-21 min. ~40% unbound in plasma (does not extensively bind RBC or albumin).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Symlin DailyMed label does not publish a normalized human Vd value. Renal clearance dominates; no bioaccumulation with repeat dosing.

regulatory_pk_rows.regulator: AIFA (Italy); NMPA (China); not approved by US FDA (orphan-drug designations only for malignant melanoma, chronic active hepatitis B, DiGeorge anomaly, hepatocellular carcinoma)
regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Zadaxin (thymalfasin) - SciClone Pharmaceuticals (US originator); Sigma-Tau / Patheon Italia S.p.A., Monza, Italy (manufacturing & EU rights)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Chronic hepatitis B (mono- or combo with interferon); chronic hepatitis C; immune adjuvant for chemotherapy-induced immunodepression and influenza vaccination in elderly/immunocompromised
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Marketed prescription drug in 35+ countries; not FDA-approved; available in the US only as an FDA-designated orphan drug (no marketing authorization) and via compounding.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Subcutaneous administration. Thymosin alpha 1 is rapidly absorbed with peak serum levels at ~2 h. Dose-proportional Cmax and AUC; serum levels return to basal by 24 h post-dose. Serum t1/2 ~2 h; no accumulation on multiple SC dosing. Urinary excretion 31-60% of administered dose.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Endogenous thymic peptide (28 aa, MW ~3108). Italian (AIFA) SmPC and SciClone product monograph do not publish a normalized human Vd. Approval-date specifics by market not retrievable from English-language sources within this batch.

regulatory_pk_rows.regulatory_status: investigational (FDA EUA twice declined for COVID-19)
regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Aviptadil / RLF-100 / Zyesami (NRx Pharmaceuticals, Relief Therapeutics)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Investigated for critical COVID-19 with respiratory failure (ACTIV-3b NIH platform; EUA filings 2021 and 2022 both declined). Orphan-drug designations for ARDS, pulmonary hypertension, sarcoidosis, asthma, cystic fibrosis. Endogenous VIP also studied historically for primary pulmonary hypertension (inhaled, Petkov 2003) and erectile dysfunction.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved. ACTIV-3b aviptadil arm stopped May 2022 for futility vs placebo. NRx subsequently sold/spun out the program; no later-stage US authorization as of 2026-04-26.
regulatory_pk_rows.vd_population: Healthy male volunteers; IV infusion of synthetic porcine VIP (Domschke 1978, Gut 19(11):1049-1053)
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Plasma VIP is rapidly degraded by neutral endopeptidase and other endopeptidases; disappearance t1/2 ~1 min after cessation of IV infusion (first-order kinetics). Apparent metabolic clearance rate ~9 mL/kg/min. Renal route accounts for ~35% of elimination at 4 h and ~90% at 24 h.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Vd value above is from the Domschke 1978 human IV-infusion study (the only published normalized human Vd for native VIP). Aviptadil PK in COVID-19 ARDS not separately characterized in registrational filings; brief plasma exposure due to ~1-min half-life.

regulatory_pk_rows.jurisdiction: United States; Russia (used in clinical practice but not registered as a marketing-authorized drug for general use)
regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Epitalon / Epithalon / AEDG tetrapeptide - Khavinson group (St Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Studied by Khavinson group for accelerated aging, retinitis pigmentosa, and longevity in elderly cohorts; companion peptide-extract (Epithalamin) reported 1.6-1.8x reduction in 6-year mortality in elderly Russian volunteers
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved as drug in US/EU. Russian clinical literature exists; Western independent replication remains sparse. Sold widely as research peptide.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Tetrapeptide Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly (MW 390.35). Rapid plasma proteolysis with t1/2 in the minutes range characteristic of small linear peptides; no formal human PK published. Bioregulator-class hypothesis posits sub-saturation transcriptional effects without classical receptor occupancy.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: All published PK and clinical data originate from a single Russian research group (Khavinson). No FDA/EMA-grade PK characterization. No normalized Vd available.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Ipamorelin (NN703) - originator Novo Nordisk; in-licensed to Helsinn Therapeutics for postoperative ileus (Phase 2b NCT01280344)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Investigated for postoperative ileus following bowel resection; pentapeptide selective ghrelin/GHS-R1a agonist. Phase 2b randomized trial failed to beat placebo on primary efficacy; development discontinued by Helsinn ~2014.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: not_approved. Sold by US compounding pharmacies and as research peptide. FDA placed ipamorelin in Category 2 of bulk drug substances for compounding (significant safety risks).
regulatory_pk_rows.vd_population: Healthy volunteers, Phase 1 IV PK study (existing atlas record cites Raun 1998, Eur J Endocrinol 139:552-561)
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Pentapeptide Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2; dose-proportional PK with terminal t1/2 ~2 h; clearance 0.078 L/h/kg; Vss 0.22 L/kg. Eliminated by proteolytic cleavage of unnatural amino-acid backbone with biliary/renal excretion of fragments.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Existing atlas record already cites Raun 1998. Helsinn Phase 2b (Gondolesi 2014, J Am Coll Surg) reported 0.03 mg/kg BID x up to 7 d well tolerated but no efficacy vs placebo. No registered Phase 3.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Pitocin (oxytocin injection, USP) - Par Pharmaceutical / Endo (current ANDA holder); generic oxytocin from multiple sponsors. Original NDA 018261.
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Induction or stimulation of labor; adjunctive management of incomplete or inevitable abortion; control of postpartum bleeding/hemorrhage
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Marketed prescription drug. Multiple synthetic-oxytocin generics on the US market. Boxed warning prohibits elective labor induction. (Note: oxytocin USP first marketed in the US as Pitocin in 1955; the 2008-02-01 date reflects the current Par/Endo NDA approval action referenced in DailyMed.)
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Plasma t1/2 1-6 min, decreased in late pregnancy and during lactation. Rapid removal from plasma by kidney and liver; only small amounts excreted unchanged in urine. Distributed throughout extracellular fluid; small amounts cross to fetal circulation. Inactivated by oxytocinase (pregnancy-associated cystyl aminopeptidase).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Pitocin label does not publish a normalized human Vd. Pre-existing atlas already cites the primary DailyMed Pitocin label; this row adds a secondary generic-oxytocin DailyMed record for cross-validation.

regulatory_pk_rows.regulatory_status: research_only (cosmetic ingredient; not an approved drug)
regulatory_pk_rows.regulator: FDA (Office of Cosmetics & Colors); CIR (Cosmetic Ingredient Review)
regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Copper tripeptide-1 / GHK-Cu - originally Iamin (Procyte; FDA-cleared as wound-healing hydrogel device-cosmetic in the 1990s but cleared product line discontinued). Marketed as INCI 'Copper Tripeptide-1' in topical cosmetics.
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Topical cosmetic ingredient (skin appearance, fine-line reduction). Not an approved injectable drug. FDA placed injectable GHK-Cu in Category 2 of the bulk drug substance compounding guidance (significant safety risks - cannot be legally compounded for injection under 503A/503B).
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Permitted as topical cosmetic ingredient; not authorized for injection by FDA. Sold widely by research-peptide vendors as 'not for human use'.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Tripeptide Gly-His-Lys (MW ~340 with Cu2+). Endogenous in human plasma at ~200 ng/mL in young adults, declining with age. Rapidly proteolyzed; chelated copper exchanges with serum albumin and ceruloplasmin. No drug-grade systemic PK characterization.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Pre-existing atlas already cites Pickart 1980. This row adds the FDA Category 2 compounding determination and CIR safety assessment as the regulatory anchor.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: CJC-1295 - originator ConjuChem Biotechnologies (Montreal). Both DAC variant (covalent albumin binder via maleimidopropionic acid linker) and non-DAC variant (Modified GRF 1-29) exist. ConjuChem terminated CJC-1295 development after the 2007-08 financial restructuring.
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: GHRH(1-29) analog studied as long-acting growth hormone secretagogue; investigated in healthy adults for GH/IGF-I axis stimulation. No registered indication. WADA-class banned at all times (S2 peptide hormones).
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not approved. Sold by US compounding pharmacies and research-peptide vendors. FDA placed CJC-1295 in Category 2 of bulk drug substances for compounding.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: DAC variant: D-Ala2/Gln8/Ala15/Leu27 GRF(1-29) modified at C-terminus with maleimidopropionic acid linker that covalently binds to Cys34 of circulating albumin, extending plasma half-life dramatically. Non-DAC variant (mod-GRF 1-29) lacks the linker and has a t1/2 of ~30 min. Eliminated by general proteolysis once cleaved from albumin.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Pre-existing atlas already cites Teichman 2006 (J Clin Endocrinol Metab 91:799-805) reporting mean t1/2 5.8-8.1 d for CJC-1295-DAC, with 2-10 fold GH increases for >=6 d and 1.5-3 fold IGF-I increases for 9-11 d. No published human Vd. This row adds Ionescu/Frohman 2006 (JCEM 91:4792-4797) as a separate single-dose follow-up.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Cagrilintide (AM833) as part of CagriSema (cagrilintide + semaglutide fixed-dose combination) - Novo Nordisk REDEFINE Phase 3 program
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Obesity / overweight with comorbidities (REDEFINE 1, NCT05567796); obesity + type 2 diabetes (REDEFINE 2, NCT05669599). Once-weekly SC. NDA filed with FDA in 2026 for CagriSema in obesity.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not yet approved as of 2026-04-26. CagriSema NDA accepted for review by FDA in early 2026; PDUFA action expected later in 2026. REDEFINE 1 reported 22.7% mean weight reduction at 68 weeks (cagrilintide + semaglutide), missing the pre-specified 25% target.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: C18 fatty diacid acylated long-acting amylin analog (37 aa peptide). Albumin binding via fatty-acid moiety (analogous to liraglutide/semaglutide design) extends plasma t1/2 to a reported range of ~159-195 hours (~6.6-8.1 days) in healthy volunteers (Enebo 2021 Lancet, PMID 33894838), supporting once-weekly SC. Eliminated by proteolysis once dissociated from albumin.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Enebo 2021 (Lancet 397:1736-1748) Phase 1b co-administration with semaglutide reports steady-state PK consistent with once-weekly SC dosing; explicit Vd and clearance values not published in the abstract. Lau 2021 (J Med Chem) discloses the medicinal-chemistry development and preclinical PK (rat t1/2 ~159-195 h).

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Geref (sermorelin acetate) - Ares-Serono / EMD Serono. NDA 19-863 (0.05 mg/amp; approved Dec 1990); NDA 20-443 (0.5 / 1.0 mg/vial; approved 1997-09-26). Both NDAs withdrawn 2009-06-18 following voluntary discontinuation by EMD Serono in 2008. FDA determined withdrawal was not for safety or effectiveness reasons (Federal Register 2013-03-04).
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Originally approved for diagnostic evaluation of pituitary somatotrope function (0.05 mg/amp) and as therapy for idiopathic growth hormone deficiency in pre-pubertal children (0.5 / 1.0 mg/vial)
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: No longer marketed as Geref in US. Available only as compounded peptide via 503A pharmacies. FDA placed sermorelin in Category 1 of bulk drug substances for compounding (eligible for use under 503A pharmacy compounding) in the 2024 PCAC review.
regulatory_pk_rows.vd_population: Twelve normal-weight adult volunteers; IV bolus 0.25-1.0 mg sermorelin (Geref archived label / SmPC, IPHA Ireland mirror)
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: 29-aa N-terminal fragment of human GHRH. IV t1/2 11-12 min (some sources 6-7 min); SC t1/2 also ~11-12 min; SC absolute bioavailability ~6%; SC peak concentration in 5-20 min. Plasma clearance 2.4-2.8 L/min. Rapidly cleaved by dipeptidyl peptidase-IV at the N-terminus and by other endopeptidases.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Pre-existing atlas already cites the Geref FDA archived label. This row adds the IPHA Ireland / SmPC mirror to make Vd attribution traceable, and the Federal Register withdrawal notice to confirm regulatory status.

dosing_rows.use_label: Mealtime adjunct to insulin in T1D and insulin-using T2D (Symlin label)
dosing_rows.population: Adults with T1D (initiate 15 mcg SC immediately before each major meal; titrate by 15-mcg increments to target 30-60 mcg as tolerated). Adults with insulin-using T2D (initiate 60 mcg SC pre-meal; titrate to 120 mcg).
dosing_rows.site: abdomen or thigh; not co-injection-site with insulin
dosing_rows.frequency: with each major meal containing >=30 g carbohydrate or >=250 kcal
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Concurrent prandial insulin dose reduced by 50% at initiation per boxed-warning protocol. Hold pramlintide if prandial insulin reduction not feasible.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Slows gastric emptying, suppresses post-prandial glucagon, reduces post-prandial glucose excursions; modest A1c reduction (~0.3-0.5%) and modest weight loss in pivotal trials.

dosing_rows.use_label: Chronic hepatitis B (Zadaxin SmPC, 35+ ex-US markets)
dosing_rows.population: Adults with chronic hepatitis B; immune adjuvant for chemotherapy-induced immunodepression in oncology indications per market
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Lyophilized vial reconstituted with 1 mL provided diluent; injected within 30 min of reconstitution.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Reported HBV DNA clearance and ALT normalization rates comparable to or additive with interferon in published RCTs; immune-modulatory mechanism via TLR2/TLR9 dendritic cell activation.

dosing_rows.population: Pregnant women with medical indication for labor induction (e.g., PROM, postdates with maternal indication)
dosing_rows.amount: 0.5-1 (initial); titrate up to 6 mU/min typical max
dosing_rows.frequency: continuous IV infusion via controlled infusion device
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Increase by 1-2 mU/min increments at intervals not less than 30 min until adequate uterine contraction pattern (3 contractions per 10 min, each lasting 40-60 sec). Discontinue if hyperstimulation or fetal distress.
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Rhythmic uterine contractions for cervical effacement and progression of labor; postpartum dose 10 IU IM or by IV infusion to control bleeding.

citations.title: Finnrick Analytics product pages for batch-4 peptides (sermorelin, cjc-1295, ghk-cu, cagrilintide, ipamorelin) and paid-test landings (vip, epithalon)
citations.notes: Finnrick has completed product testing pages for ipamorelin (https://www.finnrick.com/products/ipamorelin - 274 samples / 51 vendors), cjc-1295 (https://www.finnrick.com/products/cjc-1295 - 249 samples / 47 vendors), ghk-cu (https://www.finnrick.com/products/ghk-cu - 423 samples / 54 vendors), cagrilintide (https://www.finnrick.com/products/cagrilintide - 106 samples / 18 vendors), and sermorelin (https://www.finnrick.com/products/sermorelin - 23 samples / 5 vendors). VIP and epithalon are paid-test landings only (https://www.finnrick.com/product-test/vip?i=ft, https://www.finnrick.com/product-test/epithalon?i=ft). Pramlintide, thymosin-alpha-1, and oxytocin are not on the Finnrick index. Per atlas Finnrick rule, COA-graded vendor data lives at /products/{slug}/{vendor} - but Finnrick top-rated vendors for batch-4 peptides (e.g., Peptide Partners, Pure Tested Peptides, Atomik Labz, NuLife Peptides, Peptidology, Bulk Peptide Wholesale, Kerisite Shenzhen) are predominantly bulk/B2B sources or B2C not on this batch's vendor preference list (Core Peptides, Ascension, Umbrella, Peptide Sciences). Vendor-quality lab_grade/lab_score for the priced rows above remains null in this batch because none of those four preferred vendors appear in the Finnrick top-grade rankings for the relevant peptides verified at scrape time (note: Peptide Sciences is Grade A on ipamorelin and Grade B on ghk-cu, but Peptide Sciences' product pages returned 403 to scrape, so price rows for those two peptides were taken from Core Peptides / Ascension instead - lab grade not transferable across vendors).

questions.issue: Symlin DailyMed label does not publish a normalized human Vd value, despite providing t1/2 and bioavailability. The protein-binding statement (~40% unbound; not extensively bound to RBC or albumin) is not equivalent to a Vd.
questions.why_it_blocks: volume_of_distribution must remain null. Peptocopeia hint mentioned 'Vd ~250 mL/kg' but I could not locate this in the current 2019 DailyMed label or the 2005/2007 access-data label - it may be in the 2007 supplement or a clinical-pharmacology review I did not retrieve.

questions.issue: No verified research-peptide vendor source found within the preferred vendor set (Core Peptides, Ascension Peptides, Umbrella Labs, Peptide Sciences). Symlin is FDA-approved and prescription-only; pramlintide research peptide supply is sparse and not stocked by the preferred vendors at scrape time.
questions.why_it_blocks: price_observations row deferred. Need to vet a non-preferred vendor (e.g., Tom Richards, Peptide Source, ResearchPeptides.com) before emitting a pramlintide research price.

questions.issue: Italian AIFA SmPC and AIFA approval-date register entry not retrievable in English within this batch.
questions.why_it_blocks: approval_or_status_date left null. SciClone product monograph (2011 PDF mirror) is regulatory-quality but not jurisdiction-authoritative for the AIFA approval date itself.

questions.issue: SciClone monograph reports SC PK (Tmax ~2 h, t1/2 ~2 h, dose-prop, urinary 31-60%) but does not publish a normalized Vd.
questions.why_it_blocks: volume_of_distribution remains null.

questions.issue: Finnrick has no completed product page for thymosin-alpha-1 (not on product index).
questions.why_it_blocks: lab_grade / lab_score remain null on the price observation.

questions.issue: Vd value (14 mL/kg) is from Domschke 1978 IV-infusion of synthetic porcine VIP in healthy volunteers, not human aviptadil; the value is the only published normalized human Vd available.
questions.why_it_blocks: Atlas should note the Vd attribution covers native VIP, not the aviptadil formulation, in case downstream UI distinguishes the two.

questions.issue: Finnrick page is paid-request only (https://www.finnrick.com/product-test/vip?i=ft); no completed COA aggregation.
questions.why_it_blocks: Vendor-quality row remains null.

questions.issue: All published PK and clinical evidence originate from a single Russian research group (Khavinson, St Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology). No independent Western replication of Vd, t1/2, or mortality outcomes.
questions.why_it_blocks: PK fields remain null beyond the qualitative t1/2-in-minutes statement.

questions.issue: Finnrick page is paid-request only.
questions.why_it_blocks: Vendor-quality row remains null.

questions.issue: Atlas already cites Raun 1998 for Vd and t1/2; Gondolesi 2014 (added here) reports Phase 2b efficacy failure but not new PK normalization.
questions.why_it_blocks: Vd value (0.22 L/kg) is reproduced for traceability but no new normalization is added.

questions.issue: Finnrick top-rated vendors (Peptide Partners, Peptide Sciences) are not part of the priced row above (Core Peptides + Ascension). Peptide Sciences' product pages returned HTTP 403 to scrape.
questions.why_it_blocks: Cannot transfer Finnrick lab_grade A from Peptide Sciences onto the Core Peptides / Ascension price observations - those vendors are graded separately on Finnrick (would need /products/ipamorelin/core-peptides or /products/ipamorelin/ascension-peptides URLs to confirm).

questions.issue: Pitocin DailyMed label does not publish a normalized Vd. Atlas already cites the primary Pitocin DailyMed label, so this row only adds a secondary generic-oxytocin DailyMed entry.
questions.why_it_blocks: volume_of_distribution must remain null at the human-PK level. (Older literature, e.g., Fabian 1969, reports an apparent Vd similar to extracellular fluid volume but does not normalize it for current label use.)

questions.issue: Finnrick has no completed product page for oxytocin (not on product index).
questions.why_it_blocks: Cannot add a Finnrick-graded row; price observation lab_grade remains null.

questions.issue: FDA Category 2 compounding designation prohibits injectable use under 503A/503B but does not affect topical cosmetic use. Atlas may want a separate boolean flag for 'injectable_compounding_eligible'.
questions.why_it_blocks: regulatory_status field oversimplifies a route-dependent regulatory profile.

questions.issue: Finnrick top-rated vendors (Peptidology, Pharma Grade Peptides, Bulk Peptide Wholesale, Atomik Labz) are not on the preferred vendor list. Peptide Sciences (Grade B on Finnrick GHK-Cu) returned 403 to scrape.
questions.why_it_blocks: lab_grade / lab_score remain null on the Core Peptides price row.

questions.issue: Pre-existing atlas cites Teichman 2006 for the DAC variant. The vendor product priced here is the NON-DAC variant (Modified GRF 1-29) which has very different PK (t1/2 ~30 min instead of 5.8-8.1 d). Atlas may need a separate slug or a DAC/non-DAC discriminator.
questions.why_it_blocks: Single peptide_id 'cjc-1295' conflates two pharmacologically distinct molecules. Suggest splitting into 'cjc-1295-dac' and 'cjc-1295-no-dac' (mod-GRF) entries.

questions.issue: Finnrick top-rated vendors (Pure Tested Peptides, NuLife Peptides, Atomik Labz, Bulk Peptide Wholesale) not on preferred vendor list. The priced Core Peptides blend is also not yet vetted with a /products/cjc-1295/core-peptides Finnrick endpoint at scrape time.
questions.why_it_blocks: lab_grade / lab_score remain null.

questions.issue: Enebo 2021 Lancet abstract lists Vd as an exploratory PK endpoint but the public abstract does not disclose the value. Lau 2021 J Med Chem reports preclinical rat PK only.
questions.why_it_blocks: volume_of_distribution remains null until the FDA briefing document or full Lancet supplement is reviewed post-NDA action.

questions.issue: Finnrick best-vendors (Kerisite Shenzhen, Reta-Peptide) are not on the preferred vendor list. Umbrella Labs (priced row) was not separately rated on Finnrick's cagrilintide page at scrape time.
questions.why_it_blocks: lab_grade / lab_score remain null on the Umbrella Labs price observation.

questions.issue: Atlas already cites the Geref FDA archived label. This batch adds the IPHA Ireland SmPC mirror (which contains the Vd 23.7-25.8 L value) and the Federal Register withdrawal notice. Atlas may want to consolidate the canonical PK source as the IPHA mirror since it is more accessible than the archived FDA pre-1996 PDF.
questions.why_it_blocks: No blocker; flagged for atlas curation.

questions.issue: Finnrick sermorelin page covers only 5 (largely Chinese B2B) vendors with avg quality grades B-F. Core Peptides not separately tested.
